messages:
maya: heads-up — hitting the silent window in 30m. passing handoff to @sam for the next 2h. primary asks: who owns the pin for v3.4.2, and explicit rollforward vs rollback rules?

sam: i got it. i'll own the pin until 02:30 UTC. pin is currently set on deploy-bot as `v3.4.2-pin-maya`.

carla: quick note — release notes pushed to /releases/3.4.2. non-breaking config tweak + embeddings model swap. no data migrations.

lia: rollback criteria — if error rate > 5% on the canary tier for 15m OR latency p50 > 600ms for 10m, initiate rollback. confirm? :eyes:

sam: yes, that's the threshold we agreed. add: if memory OOMs observed on gpu-pool-2 twice within 5m, roll back immediately.

maya: adding a soft rollforward rule: if canary is green for 40m and no regressions in eval suite, we can rollforward to 30% traffic. will update the runbook.

deploy-bot: [INFO] pin created: `v3.4.2-pin-maya` by sam at 5051234321. canary started on canary-3 (instances 3/3 warm). streaming logs -> https://logs/redwood/canary/3.4.2

lia: ok — pin owner (sam) will own immediate rollback/unpin ops. Oncall (lia) watches metrics and will call rollback if thresholds exceeded.

sam: emergency unpin procedure (copy):
```
# emergency unpin
/deploy unpin v3.4.2-pin-maya --reason "emergency rollback" --notify #eng-oncall
/deploy promote v3.4.1 --target production
```

maya: can we add a guard: deploy-bot to refuse unpin unless confirm from pin owner OR 2nd approver in #eng-oncall?

opsbot: policy check: current policy requires either pin owner OR 2 approvers for unpin during silent window. auto-fallback will route to backup-owner if pin owner unreachable.

carla: sending final release note blurb to marketing now. tagging support with known limitations.

lia: quick checklist reminder before we go silent:
- smoke tests ✅
- canary probes ✅
- [metric alerts] 5% error / 600ms p50 thresholds set ✅
- rollback runbook linked ✅
- backups: snapshot at 5051234300 ✅

sam: i'm on watch. i'll ping here at start of silent window and at +30m. Maya — thx for the handoff. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all. leaving the thread. call me if anything weird pops up.
